title: `arguments/epiphenomenalism-argument` states the evolutionary and self-stultification arguments without limits the corpus has already drawn: L95 "Interactionism explains both" ignores the selectability constraint (`topics/inheritance-problem-for-the-psychophysical-law` §selectability: evolution sees a selector only if it shifts fitness-relevant frequencies, which strict Born-preservation forbids), and Argument 1 never notes that an authority-only (trumping) law "cannot carry the self-stultification argument" (`concepts/trumping-preemption` L81)
